'''Haken''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Republic officer/Legends|Republic officer]] who was [[Executive officer/Legends|second in command]] of the [[Esseles (starship)|''Esseles'']] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
Haken was a human male who served on the Republic cruiser ''Esseles'' during the Cold War. Eventually, he had become the [[Executive officer/Legends|First Officer]] of the ship—the second in command.

In [[3643 BBY]], the ''Esseles'' was en route to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] when [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Rycus Kilran]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] [[Assault on the Esseles|attacked]] the ship in an effort to capture the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] [[Vyn Asara]], who was aboard at the time. Kilran's forces boarded the ''Esseles'' as Kilran's ship bombarded the other, causing the death of Haken's superior. This left Haken in charge of the vessel just as a group [[The Barsen'thor|of]] [[Hero of Tython|Jedi]], [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|troopers]], and [[Voidhound|smugglers]] who were aboard arrived on the bridge. Kilran chose this moment to contact the ''Esseles'', informing them that they were caught in a tractor beam and that his forces were searching for a Republic ambassador who had been confirmed to be aboard by Kilran's agents.

Haken sent the group to combat the invaders, but it turned out that it had been a diversion: the real threat was a squad of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] led by the veteran [[Ironfist]], who attacked and seized the bridge. After restoring access to the bridge, the allies encountered Ironfist, who had captured Haken, Navigator [[Plex]], Communications Officer [[Raste]], and the rest of the command crew. Haken and the others begged the heroes to free them, and they watched as the group defeated Ironfist and his group of Mandalorians.

After the crew was freed, Asara convinced the group to take one of the Esseles' shuttles over to Kilran's ship and disable the tractor beam holding the cruiser. Haken agreed, but he attempted to convince the group to leave the ambassador on Kilran's ship to ensure the Imperials would not follow. They refused and later told Asara of Haken's treachery after they disabled the tractor beam. Asara thanked them for informing her, and confronted Haken when they arrived back on the ''Esseles''. Thanks to the efforts of the allies, the ''Esseles'' was able to continue on its way to Coruscant, where the ambassador could continue her mission.

==Behind the scenes==
The Republic-affiliated player can choose to not tell Asara of Haken's treachery or inform Asara of Haken's treachery before leaving her with the Imperials.
